Attached: 1 video

Check your Kubernetes cluster for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938), no scanner needed:

brew install kubectl-radar && kubectl radar check java4shell -A

Only recent x86 CPUs are affected, so Radar reads the Java version in each running container plus the CPU of the node it runs on, and gives you a short list of what to patch first.

Running Trivy Operator? v1.21 also adds a Vulnerabilities view that only counts what's actually running.
